messages:
jordan: Kicking off v2 rollout for /api/generate. Starting a 5% canary now. Will monitor latency and error rate. release notes: https://redwood.dev/release/v2 - pls scan for client-impact items

deploy-bot: Started canary deploy: v2 -> 5% traffic (shard: canary-a). Snapshot id: snap-2026-03-20-01 :rocket:

sarah: quick heads-up — auth TTL header name changed in v2 from `X-RW-Auth-TTL` -> `X-RW-TTL`. mobile SDKs read the old header. recommend pin mobile to v1 until we confirm compatibility.

abhi: rollback criteria proposal: trigger if 5m error rate > 1% OR auth failure rate > 0.7% sustained for 2 consecutive 5m windows. Also monitor 99p latency + tail.

maria: i just ran compatibility smoke on staging mobile build — saw auth header mismatch on ios 1.3.2 (old SDK). Failing calls show `missing ttl header`.

opsbot: Metrics snapshot (canary-a 5%):
- overall error rate: 0.34%
- auth failures: 2.1% (mobile cluster)
- p99 latency: 420ms
logs (sample):
```
[2026-03-20T01:02:11Z] mobile/ios auth: no header X-RW-TTL found, X-RW-Auth-TTL present
[2026-03-20T01:02:12Z] proxy: 401 auth-ttl-missing
```

tim: can we add a short-term header-compat shim in the gateway that maps `X-RW-Auth-TTL` -> `X-RW-TTL`? low-risk fix and lets us continue canary for non-mobile clients.

ajordan: @tim yeah that's the plan. @eng-runtime — can we deploy a config-only shim to accept both headers and normalize to X-RW-TTL? small config change, no model changes.

abhi: if shim is fast (<30m) we can continue canary for web + server SDKs. mobile stays pinned to v1. update rollback triggers to include auth-failure metric as above.

deploy-bot: Operator action requested: pause canary on mobile routes. Reason: auth header incompatibility detected. Paused shards: canary-a-mobile. Initiator: @jordan

sarah: I'll update the release notes and add a clear breaking-change callout and migration snippet (example accept-header shim). Will ping mobile eng leads.

maria: filing a quick bug with mobile team and tagging SDK owners now.

jordan: pausing full rollout. Mobile routes held at v1. Web/server traffic continues at 5% with header shim pending. Reconvene in 30m for status. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary status: partial pause applied. canary-a (web): 5% active. canary-a-mobile: paused by operator. Next automated check in 5m.
